description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Chitra Weerakkody and Sri Lanka Transport Board. 2. Industrial Dispute between H. G. Rathnayaka and Sri Lanka Transport Board.
categorisation: This gazette contains orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves the application of existing laws and regulations to specific industrial disputes. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory appointments of arbitrators, and references to legislative enactments, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
